scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @omni/shared && npm run build -w @omni/auth && npm run build -w @omni/queue && npm run build -w @omni/platform-core && npm run build -w @omni/platform-zalo && npm run build -w @omni/platform-facebook && npm run build -w @omni/platform-tiktok && npm run build -w @omni/database && npm run build -w @omni/ui
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @omni/api && npm run build -w @omni/worker && npm run build -w @omni/scheduler && npm run build -w @omni/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker,scheduler -c blue,magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @omni/api" "npm run dev -w @omni/web" "npm run dev -w @omni/worker" "npm run dev -w @omni/scheduler"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
